question: Which syllable must be placed on the trident point and used to encircle it?
premises: The ham-syllable is placed on the trident point.
The encircling is done with the ham-syllable.
inference: The practitioner places the ham-syllable on the trident point and encircles it with the ham-syllable.
plain_english: On the point of the trident one should place the ham-syllable and encircle it with the ham-syllable.
